name: Mode sign
notes: A wooden sign of the menu map's Green Meadow, one per game mode: CLASSIC (left), CLEAR SAVE (middle) and, once all 9 monsters are freed, WAVES (right: its appear_if needs unlocked >= 9). The sign itself shows no words: walking up to it shows its name over the monster's head (plr_menu, head_label), and A or B there picks it. Solid: the monster bumps into it.
